features.name: Cutscenes, title screen and logos always skippable
features.readme: Cutscenes are always skippable
features.effect_without_code: The stock skip rules apply: cutscenes, title animation and intro logos are skippable only where the original game allows it.
features.reimpl_note: Removes three conditional branches (two in the cutscene player, one in the title sequence) and adds a start-button test to the logo sequence.

features.name: Select Mode shortcuts and extra stage entries
features.readme: Select Mode usability (Last Way and Devil Doom entries, cursor memory, start-message shortcut)
features.effect_without_code: No X shortcut on the start message, the stage cursor resets to the first stage, and The Last Way / Devil Doom get no select entries. Reloaded's SelectMode layout and textures are still loaded by the stock menu.
features.reimpl_note: One hook in the select menu plus two table words that add the entries; the art is already in the mod's files.

library_entries.entry: Last Way & Devil Doom in Select Menu v2

features.name: Last Story unlocks after 3 story endings
features.readme: Last Story unlocks after 3 endings instead of 10
features.effect_without_code: Last Story needs all ten endings, as in the original.
features.reimpl_note: One compare constant (10 to 3) in the unlock test.

features.name: Expert Mode unlocks by beating Last Story
features.readme: Expert Mode unlocks after Last Story instead of every A rank
features.effect_without_code: Expert Mode keeps the original unlock rule (every mission ranked A).
features.reimpl_note: Three hooks in the rank/progress code (unlock on Last Story clear, two bug fixes in the A-rank count).

features.name: Practise Expert stages from Select Mode
features.readme: Expert levels can be practised in Select Mode with X
features.effect_without_code: Select Mode cannot start the Expert version of a stage. The hard-mode layouts (stgNNNN_hrd.dat) are only read when a normal Expert run is started, which still needs the original unlock.
features.reimpl_note: Needs the select menu to set the same hard-mode flag the Expert run sets (G+0x125 per docs/STAGE_LOADING.md), plus lives/progress handling.

library_entries.entry: Dont Update Expert Progress In Select Mode
Prevent Saving Expert Lives in Select Mode

features.name: Unique Expert Mode ending
features.readme: Expert Mode has a unique ending animation
features.effect_without_code: The Expert ending plays the stock movies and music. The six .flo movies and sng_EV_music4.adx are never opened: the stock DOL names only .sfd movies and sng_EV_music1..3, and the Reloaded code rewrites those name strings at run time when the Expert run starts.
features.reimpl_note: A name-string switch (extension and music digit) when the game kind is Expert; a native version could resolve the names through the file layer instead.

features.name: Expert Mode: a hit costs all rings
features.readme: (part of the Expert Mode rework)
features.effect_without_code: Expert Mode rings behave as in the original.
features.reimpl_note: Two hooks in the damage code.

features.name: Mission lock-in and always-switchable missions
features.readme: Partners do not change your mission when you locked one in
features.effect_without_code: Partners still swap the active mission as you pass them; missions can only be switched after meeting the partner.
features.reimpl_note: Seven hooks and one free flag byte; behaviour logic, not data.

features.name: No partner camera introductions
features.readme: Partner characters no longer stop you with a camera zoom
features.effect_without_code: The camera introduction plays when the partner is first met. Observed on this build: Westopolis with Reloaded's remixed layout, game tick 1.2e9 (frame 1737) shows the Sonic introduction camera and subtitle where stock shows Shadow running.
features.reimpl_note: One conditional branch made unconditional.

features.name: More forgiving mission requirements
features.readme: Many missions allow missing a few enemies or objects
features.effect_without_code: Works as intended: the stock code reads nukkoro2.inf (two reads seen in the asset trace of a boot) and Reloaded's file is larger (12,702 bytes against 9,769). nukkoro.inf only drops comments, its 9 settings are unchanged.
features.reimpl_note: Nothing to do.

features.name: S Rank
features.readme: S Rank added to the rank system
features.effect_without_code: The rank score table is read by the stock rank code (ScoreData.bin is opened at stage start) but the S letter, the S-aware A-rank counters and the Devil Doom result screen are code. Result: stock rank letters computed from Reloaded's table. ScoreDatb.bin is named nowhere in either DOL (inert).
features.reimpl_note: Table already in the files; the display and counters need the rank code changed.

library_entries.entry: Devil Doom is a Ranked Mission

features.name: Red Rings instead of Secret Keys, ghost Red Rings
features.readme: Secret Keys replaced by Red Rings
features.effect_without_code: The key objects (class SECRETKEY, 115 in the stock layouts and 115 in Reloaded's, same count) are drawn with Reloaded's red-ring model from stg_cmn_gdt.one. The ghost state is missing: stg_cmn_gd2.one is only selected by the Reloaded code (it rewrites one letter of the archive name, gdt to gd2) and is never opened. The 26 stock SECRETDOOR objects are gone from the layouts, so keys no longer open anything.
features.reimpl_note: Needs the per-stage all-five-collected state and the archive switch; the ghost models are already in the files.

features.name: Secret doors reworked into extra routes
features.readme: Secret door system reworked into additional pathways
features.effect_without_code: Works as data: the layouts contain only object classes the stock game already has (no new class, no new parameter length), SECRETDOOR is simply no longer placed (26 to 0) and the extra routes are layout, block and path data.
features.reimpl_note: Nothing to do.

features.name: Stage remixes, boss-stage layouts, Lost Impact area
features.readme: Levels remixed; inaccessible Lost Impact area reachable; faster waiting sections
features.effect_without_code: Works as intended with the stock loader. Boss stages get new normal and hard layouts (stg0210, 0310, 0410 to 0412, 0510, 0511 and 0610 to 0618: 16 stages, 32 new files) that the stock layout loader asks for by name (stg0210_nrm.dat read at pc 0x800CB1C0 in a boot on this build). Reloaded trimmed 14 stage archives (stg*_gdt.one and one fx archive lose 21 to 131 members each); they only suit Reloaded's own layouts. The Diablon boss gimmick of the hard layout also needs the 'Diablon warp' code change.
features.reimpl_note: Nothing to do for layouts; mixing Reloaded stage archives with another mod's layouts is unsafe (missing members).

features.name: In-game time for speedruns (ShadowSX timing, Race Mode)
features.readme: In-game timing usable for speedruns
features.effect_without_code: Stock timer and HUD. The IGT message that Reloaded shows before autosave (text ids 43 and 44 redirected to a custom string by the code) is not shown; the font/subtitle files are otherwise normal. Many entries cite helper .asm files that Reloaded's repository does not ship; the injected code itself is in the DOL.
features.reimpl_note: About 30 hooks and a dozen free flag words; a native timer would be a new feature rather than a patch.

features.name: Lives, checkpoints and score rules
features.readme: (rules tweaks)
features.effect_without_code: Lives count down and restarts cost lives as in the original; respawn uses the highest checkpoint id; time bonus uses the original curve; Last Way hero/dark points count as in stock.
features.reimpl_note: Few instructions each.

features.name: Shadow movement and object tuning constants
features.readme: Shadow is faster and more responsive
features.effect_without_code: Stock values: each tweak is a number in the DOL's constant data (or a one-instruction change), not a file. Nothing of this reaches the PC build.
features.reimpl_note: Most are float words in the DOL data area (listed below with their PAL addresses and stock/Reloaded values); a runtime constant-override table would apply them without code. The five that change instructions (LightDash transitions, ValidRing distance, run threshold, spindash delay, strafe speed) swap a float load for an immediate value.

library_entries.entry: LightDash Exit State Change to Launched for Westopolis
Keep Melee Weapons when Mounting Vehicles

features.name: Hold L to Jump Dash instead of Homing Attack
features.readme: Hold L performs a Jump Dash instead of a Homing Attack
features.effect_without_code: L does nothing extra; the homing attack always targets.
features.reimpl_note: One hook reading the pad state.

library_entries.entry: Hold L to JumpDash instead of HomingAttack v5

features.name: Slide changes (hold to slide, slide out of attacks, steer, fixes)
features.readme: Shadow can slide out of spindash, homing attack and jump dash; slide length is player controlled
features.effect_without_code: Stock slide (B on the ground, fixed duration).
features.reimpl_note: Several hooks in the player ground/slide behaviours.

library_entries.entry: Disable Slide on B-press on ground and state extension V3
Slide State Extension - Bad Transition Bugfix

features.name: Melee weapons rework (hold B, Z switches style)
features.readme: Z toggles Original and Reloaded melee weapon styles; hold B for the hitbox
features.effect_without_code: Melee weapons work the stock way. Reloaded's SHADOW.MTP (the 158-clip motion pack, +7,480 bytes) is loaded by the stock state code; the library marks the pack as required by the new code, so some melee/jump clips may not match the stock states (not looked at in play). Ammo counts are DOL constants, unchanged.
features.reimpl_note: Eleven hooks and a modified motion pack; both halves are needed.

features.name: Cyber circuit speed control (A faster, B slower)
features.readme: A and B change speed on the cyberspace circuits
features.effect_without_code: Circuit speed is fixed as in the original.
features.reimpl_note: One hook reading pad state, patches one speed constant.

features.name: Vehicle handling: cars, bikes, GUN mechs, Air Saucer
features.readme: Cars/motorcycles accelerate with A taps; Air Saucers more mobile with a downward spike
features.effect_without_code: Original vehicle physics and controls. Air Saucer speeds are DOL constants.
features.reimpl_note: Hooks in the vehicle update code plus a few constants.

library_entries.entry: AirSaucer Replace Second Jump with Stomp

features.name: Weapon, enemy and boss balance
features.readme: (balance changes)
features.effect_without_code: Original damage, health and timing values.
features.reimpl_note: Mostly float words (health, damage, timers) in the DOL data; four entries change instructions (invulnerability frames, knockback, charged spears).

library_entries.entry: Cannon & Lock On Weapons No Knockback
SuperShadow Always Has Fully Charged Spears while ChaosPowers Active

features.name: Stage and boss bug fixes
features.readme: Bug fixes and oversights
features.effect_without_code: The original bugs remain (for example the Armored Egg Pierrot model on Air Fleet, and coaster collision). Layouts made for the changed behaviour (Diablon hard layout, collision-trigger objects) run with the original behaviour.
features.reimpl_note: One or two instructions each.

library_entries.entry: Devil Doom Boss Has No Awake Music

features.name: Restored music: ending tracks and Lava Shelter Egg Dealer remix
features.readme: Unused tracks added to boss fight and endings
features.effect_without_code: Endings and the Lava Shelter boss use the original tracks. sng_vox07.adx and sng_stg0613.adx are never opened (the code patches a digit inside the stock track-name strings per stage); sng_vox06.adx is Reloaded's replacement of an existing track and is played wherever the stock game plays vox06.
features.reimpl_note: Digit patches of three name strings by stage id; a native file-name table could do the same.

library_entries.entry: Music Update Ending Tracks and Lava Shelter Boss

features.name: Restored dialogue, Last Way idle lines, new voice entries
features.readme: Some unused dialogue restored
features.effect_without_code: Voice entries, subtitles and event files load and play where the stock code asks for them. The table of four idle-line ids in the DOL (NTSC-U 0x80509914) keeps the stock ids, so the restored lines Reloaded points it at are never chosen.
features.reimpl_note: Only the four-word id table needs code; the rest is files.

features.readme: Widescreen and 4:3 ratio options
features.effect_without_code: The mod's UI layout files (gncp) are drawn on this build's own widescreen path; the Dolphin-style projection patches are absent. The layouts were adjusted for Reloaded's code, so HUD placement may differ (not compared pixel by pixel).
features.reimpl_note: This build has its own aspect handling; the code is not wanted.

features.name: Model, texture, movie-frame and palette fixes
features.readme: Visual fixes (Maria's eyes, HP bar pixel, Chaos eye glow, Bigfoot glare, ring inhibitors, Commander hands, emerald colour, stage palettes)
